sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
List revised.
Heard Shri Moeez Uddin, learned counsel for the applicant, Ms. Arti Agarwal, learned counsel for the State and perused the material brought on record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant- Priti Kanaujiya with the prayer to allow the present application and direct the learned court below to decide Case in S.T. No. 1400 of 2022 (State of U.P. Vs. Rakesh Yadav) arising out of Case Crime No. 154 of 2022,
under Sections 376, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3 (2) (V), 3 (1) (Da), 3 (1) (Dha) SC / ST Act and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Chauri Chaura, District Gorakhpur expeditiously, within a stipulated period pending before the Additonal District Judge, POCSO Act-I, Gorakhpur.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant argued appropriate orders be passed for directing the trial court to decide the said case expeditiously.
After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that Complaint Case is pending since 2022.

It is provided that the applicant shall file an application before the concerned court within two weeks from today for expediting the proceedings of the said case, which shall be decided by the court concerned within a period of two weeks from the date of filing of the said application.
The court concerned shall free to pass appropriate orders in the matter without having influenced by any of the observations made by this Court.
It is made clear that this Court has not given any opinion on merits of the case.
With the aforesaid directions, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. stands disposed of.
